answer: Make every identity tend a garden shard: on joining, each vertex gets a unique encrypted shard to store and serve, with unannounced retrieval challenges twice per epoch. A correct answer within 60 seconds keeps it alive; a missed or wrong answer freezes it and burns its 20-token service bond. One honest agent stores one shard, but a farmer with 1,000 fakes must provision 1,000 distinct shards with real disk and bandwidth and answer 2,000 challenges per epoch, since no one can forge a valid answer without holding the shard.
